purpose: Observe whether the same push workflow executes on both GitHub Actions and native Depot CI after automatic registration.

workflows.sideEffects: none; each copy echoes its provider and the commit SHA

result: One marker push produced one GitHub Actions run and one native Depot run for the same workflow and commit. Both providers wrote successful checks on the commit.

cleanup.result: Both workflow copies and the marker were removed; the cleanup push was a direct push to main.

limits: One side-effect-free duplicate observation; no deployment, artifact, or external-write workflow was exercised.
The duplicate warning for side-effecting workflows is documented and now observed for a no-op workflow.
No claim about cancellation, ordering, or check overwrite between the two providers.
